stopping_rules.rule: Before any affected invocation, this child artifact-binding amendment must be registered, frozen, and committed; every bound manifest, source/recipe/toolchain, build.json, executable path/size/mode/SHA-256, and SHA256SUMS value must verify. Otherwise return blocked_artifact_or_isolation and collect zero fingerprints, tests, benchmark rows, or profiles.

Fixed wall N is 44 cells x 2 thread panels x 6 measured rounds x 2 mirrored arms = 1,056 measured invocations. Each invocation has one discarded time-based warmup phase (at least one call and until 0.2 seconds), then emits 3..5 samples under samples=5,min_samples=3,max-seconds=2.0. Never replace an invocation; retain its actual sample count.

Execute four unprofiled wall sessions in order rust-1t,c-1t,rust-4t,c-4t. Rounds 1/3/5 run A then B and 2/4/6 run B then A per deterministically shuffled cell; expected Rust/C schedule hashes must match.

After the unprofiled wall panel, attempt exactly 44 cells x 2 arms = 88 one-thread Callgrind complete-region diagnostics with pinned Valgrind 3.28.0. Retain a failure once; never replace it or alter a wall decision.

After Callgrind, attempt exactly 44 cells x 2 arms = 88 one-thread perf-stat diagnostics in lexicographic cell order and A then B order, collecting only task-clock,cpu-clock,context-switches,page-faults with pinned perf 6.12.113/libraries. Retain failures once; request no hardware event.

After perf stat, attempt exactly eight one-thread perf-record cpu-clock profiles: three fixed Rust representatives plus five C cells with largest baseline Callgrind Ir, ties lexicographic. Record baseline A once at 99 Hz with DWARF call graphs; profiles cannot change a gate.
Do not add rounds, replace failures, remove cells, change budgets, select a favorable CPU, or reinterpret the nonqualified host after clocks/profiles.

invalidation_rules: Until v4 is registered, frozen, committed, all exact source/artifact/registry/preflight identities revalidate, and the parent confirms all other local CPU work is paused, zero correctness, fingerprint, benchmark, compare, instr, raw timed run, or profiler invocations are authorized.

Any baseline source hash, globally locked build recipe, pinned tool identity, child-amendment value, build.json hash, binary hash/path/size, or manifest mismatch yields invalid_exactness_or_provenance.
Any output fingerprint mismatch across A/B, samples, six rounds, or thread panels invalidates evidence before clocks.

GF(2), Matrix-F5, F2m, and C result/work fields are fingerprint preimages bound by frozen source hashes; the harness does not emit them separately. Exact digest equality gates the vector; only invocation/sample/pair/registry counts are separately observed.

The Rust registry receipt must contain 262 unique rows and exact selection must yield exactly the 10 named Rust IDs with no suffix variant; the C registry must contain exactly 34 unique rows and --full must select all 34. Missing, duplicate, additional selected, or post-result-selected IDs invalidate the session.

F2m fixes source-level workload structure at 65,536 multiply plus 65,536 square iterations per recurrence, 2,048 inverse calls, and eight scalar multiplications; this is not a separately emitted runtime counter.
Any session order, cell set, seed, schedule hash, arm mirror, thread count, CPU mask, sample cap/minimum/budget, timeout, environment, boundary, or registry change requires a new protocol.

Any nonzero exit, timeout, crash, wrong affinity, missing row/metric, sample count outside 3..5, or fewer than six complete pairs is retained and never replaced; it yields inconclusive_contention_or_incomplete unless exactness already failed.
Any row without global lock, exact reserve/run masks/settings, or an uncontended receipt is nonqualified. Exact fields may remain reportable; wall time supports no claim.
A Valgrind/perf hash mismatch, unsupported software event, or profiler failure invalidates that diagnostic only. Retain it once; never rerun, substitute hardware events, or alter the A/A verdict.
Callgrind, perf stat/record, disassembly, setup/build time, and stage timers are diagnostic only and cannot satisfy the complete Workload::run or C k->run gate.
Any candidate arm/build/output or production-speedup interpretation is outside this amendment and returns not_authorized_candidate_comparison.
Any Rust perfindex wall or Callgrind wrapper using legacy substring --filter instead of one repeated --exact-filter per frozen ID is invalid_exactness_or_provenance.

decision_rule.text: Evaluate terminal outcomes in order. (1) If a candidate is built, introduced, or compared, return not_authorized_candidate_comparison. (2) If the frozen source/build identity, child artifact-binding amendment, or pre-data artifact manifest is absent before the first affected invocation, return blocked_artifact_or_isolation; if an observed identity, schedule, fingerprint, source-bound work contract, or registry contradicts its frozen value, return invalid_exactness_or_provenance. (3) If the global lock/isolation service cannot start, run nothing and return blocked_artifact_or_isolation. (4) If any of 1,056 planned invocations is missing/incomplete, any of 88 cells has fewer than six complete mirrored pairs, or any receipt is contended/wrong-affinity, return inconclusive_contention_or_incomplete; retain every attempted row and do not replace it. (5) If all exact/count/isolation gates pass but any cell receives a faster or slower null verdict, return baseline_aa_false_direction_nonqualified. (6) If all gates pass, all 1,056 rows are retained, all 88 cells have six pairs, and all verdicts are neutral, return baseline_aa_complete_nonqualified. The final suffix is mandatory because the frozen local KVM placement has no Tier 0/Tier 1 evidence receipt. No outcome establishes a speedup. After a candidate commit exists, a fresh protocol must be registered and frozen before affected data; it must bind exact baseline and candidate commits/binary SHA-256 values, its own A/B/A-prime schedule, correctness/work gates, qualified placement, profiler scope, complete-call thresholds, stopping rules, and promotion/rollback decisions.
decision_rule.threshold: 1,056/1,056 complete invocations; 88/88 cells with six mirrored pairs; exact source/build/artifact/schedule/fingerprint/work/isolation gates; zero faster/slower null verdicts; mandatory nonqualified-local label.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact complete-invocation count, complete-pair count, and false faster/slower verdict count, accompanied by each cell's six paired log ratios and pinned bootstrap interval.
decision_rule.interval: No candidate-effect interval is licensed. Retain perfindex's paired bootstrap interval only as a nonqualified null diagnostic.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: No production effect size. Report per-cell exp(median ln(A/B)) only as a nonqualified A/A diagnostic.

literature.claim: Source-by-source record of repository evidence, primary algorithm/instruction references, prior results, negative results, and their measurement consequences.
M4RI uses precomputed pivot-row combinations, Gray-code table construction, and cache-aware blocking for dense GF(2) elimination.
F5 signature criteria suppress reductions to zero; direct packing must leave criterion semantics and selected rows unchanged.
Rust supports runtime x86 feature detection for AVX2 and PCLMULQDQ, permitting guarded dispatch with portable fallbacks.
The binary-field curve parameters use fixed polynomial-basis irreducible polynomials; the standard supplies identities, not performance evidence.
Scientific performance reports require reproducibility, appropriate statistics, full disclosure, and meaningful baselines.
Seemingly irrelevant layout and environment changes can bias performance, motivating fresh-process alternation and exact build/environment receipts.
The immutable version-1 predecessor freezes the three prospective Rust opportunities and 34-kernel C control but has no candidate commit or executable hashes; it cannot govern pre-candidate timing.
